body.x: LUCI participated in “CES(Consumer Electronics Show) 2018 Unveiled” held on January 7, 2018 in Las Vegas, USA to introduce an immersive-type of VR display which can be used regardless of time and place.

LUCI is a company which develops solutions for the next generation immersive type of entertainment, and intends to change the way people consume the contents by way of providing them with visually wonderful experiences through the technologies by which devices can be worn by them.

Developed by LUCI, IMMERS features UHD 3000PPL display, which helps people be immersed in the contents. Furthermore, it is compact, and its design is definable by its users. With it, the user can enjoy the video as if in a premium theater regardless of time and place.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
